items.root_cause: Get-HyVeeAskOrder promotes a product on a condition the REFUSAL itself preserves: rank 1 is 'the board has no cell for this commodity because the Hy-Vee row was read at the wrong store', and a size-conflict or no-offer refusal keeps the row at its old store and old as_of, so the board still has no cell, so tomorrow the product is rank 1 again and oldest again. With 16 such products plus 4 tag-refused products that have no row (as_of '' sorts oldest of all) and a quarter budget of 20 asks, the whole daily budget is spent re-asking the same 20 refusals: a livelock (responsive, finishing nothing), not a dead API. Nothing records that a product was ASKED, only when it was last READ, so the order cannot tell 'never asked' from 'asked and refused yesterday'.

root_fix.what: order by last ASK, not last successful read, and stop re-promoting a refusal that cannot change until its input changes; make the watchdog say which failure it saw
root_fix.exact_change: (1) Invoke-HyVeeWorkPass records every ASKED pid in an ask ledger {pid: {last_asked, last_outcome, streak}} written with Write-TcAtomicFile under Enter-TcLedgerLock (lib/ledger-lock.ps1; read inside the lock). (2) Get-HyVeeAskOrder takes the ledger as a parameter (stays pure) and sorts within a rank by max(as_of, last_asked) instead of as_of, so a product asked today goes behind every product of its rank not asked since. (3) A pid whose last_outcome is 'source product size conflicts with the worklist variant' is NOT promoted to rank 0/1/2 again until its worklist size or pid changes (it keeps rank 3, oldest-first by max(as_of,last_asked)) and is listed in the file header as size_conflict_parked [pid, ours, theirs] so the binding defect is visible instead of silently re-asked; 'no usable offer' and a below-tag refusal with no prior row re-promote at most once per 7 days (last_asked gate). (4) The file header gains asked_repeat_of_yesterday (count of pids asked today that were also asked on the previous run). (5) capture-watchdog.ps1 lines 1931-1932: when the headless lane's newest file has answered>0 and refreshed_today=0, the finding reads 'ANSWERS REFUSED: Hy-Vee asked N, answered M, refreshed 0 (reasons from capture_terms)' instead of 'saw nothing', and a lane whose asked set repeats 3 runs running is its own finding 'SAME SLICE 3 DAYS'. Do NOT change the budget, the quarter, the size-conflict check or the shelf-tag check.

items.root_cause: two of the three cells are one class: a store writes a bare 'Oz' on a liquid (a 16 oz can, a 32 oz lotion) for a commodity priced per fl oz, and the size reading and the unit-basis guard disagree about whether that is volume, so a probably-real price (Venom $1.00 per 16 oz can = $0.0625/floz) is condemned and the cell shows an older, DEARER number (0.1353): overstating, which is as wrong as understating. The third is a store contradicting itself, withheld as ruled. The alert type itself is by design and each occurrence so far has had a different cause.

open_questions_for_brad.question: Should a matching change that moves or drops a product NO board cell shows still hold the whole grocery post until someone runs the soundness -Accept?
open_questions_for_brad.why_now: On 6 of 23 run days since 2026-09-01 a rule change moved or dropped names; on 2026-09-23 the post was held although the data was live, and the six names that held it this week were all wrong products correctly leaving, none on a cell.
options: A (recommended): hold the post only when a moved, dropped or contested name is a published cell's winning item; everything else stays a REVIEW line for the weekly lane, and -Accept is still how the baseline moves. Matches your 2026-09-21 ruling that one bad item does not hold the board.
B: keep the whole-post hold, and give the -Accept an owner: the daily triage reviewer accepts after a line-by-line review like this one (about one review per rule change, 6 in 25 days).
C: keep today's behaviour (the post waits for a human -Accept).
